- **Crazy_top**: Proliferating small shoots/witches'-broom appearance — not present here
- All other candidates (leaf blight, rust, virus, stalk rot) show distinctly different symptoms

The dark smutty mass at the tassel position of an otherwise still-green plant is the hallmark of **Head_smut**.
